title: RCFlatSlab
description: RCFlatSlab: Floor configuration of a two-way spanning reinforced concrete flat slab of constant thickness supported directly on columns, optionally with dropheads over the columns.

Slab.description: Surface property defining the construction and thickness of the slab. ConstantThickness: Simplest property for 2D analytical elements with a constant thickness and homogenous material across the whole element.

SlabReinforcement.description: Reinforcement of the slab, defined either as an estimated density or as an explicit layout. Can be null if no slab reinforcement is to be accounted for. ISlabReinforcement: Base interface for the reinforcement definition of the slab in a floor configuration, for example estimated as a density (EstimateSlabReinforcement) or explicitly laid out (LayoutSlabReinforcement).

Drophead.description:
Drophead in the slabs over columns. For a slab without dropheads this will be null. Drophead: Drophead on a flat slab, i.e. a local thickening of the slab over a column. Thickness is additional to the thickness of the main slab. The material of the drophead is taken from the main slab property.
Also applicable to be used with waffle slabs for a solid zone over dropheads.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
